scenes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A single landscape 16:9 cinematic 2D cut-paper story illustration for a gentle paper-spirit game. FIRST PERSON VIEW THROUGH THE SPIRIT'S EYES, NEVER show spirit face, whole body or a third-person figure. Image1 reference locks bird design: cute plump ivory bird, tiny ochre beak and feet, large round dark eyes, short paper crest, layered thin paper wing tips. Image2 reference defines the spirit's tiny rounded mitten hands and ivory layered cloak ONLY if visible, NOT the spirit face. Handmade fibrous ivory paper, softly painted 2D gouache shadows, artistic tactile paper collage, NOT a plastic 3D render. BACKGROUND deliberately minimal: charcoal brown darkness, faint paper grain, vague warm haze only; NO shelves, architecture, books, rooms, props or scenery details. No words, no UI, no captions, no panel borders. Place bird's face in upper middle, bottom quarter quiet dark for later dialogue. BEFORE waking. View from low lying-down eye level. Almost black brown paper darkness. A very faint softly rim-lit silhouette of the little bird leans toward the viewer from the upper right of center, worried head tilt. Just enough ivory paper edges and catchlights to perceive its presence. No light seed, no hands yet, no bright floor. Tender mysterious, not horror.
